title: What becomes visible
lines: A company can buy thousands of AI licenses while its most useful AI work stays unofficial.
AI Adoption Beyond the Slop follows adoption as growing dependence, far beyond trying a tool.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Contrast a conspicuous public failure with a quiet working document; avoid charts implying measured hidden success.

Speak with clear interest; lightly emphasize growing dependence. Present this specific idea in a simple conversational voice, without a grand announcement or dramatic suspense, and leave a natural pause.

title: From trial to practice
lines: A purchased license, a clever experiment, and a changed working practice tell very different stories.
The book follows the first users, and the people who help others feel comfortable trying.

title: The permission gap
lines: It asks why someone might rely on AI privately while avoiding the subject with colleagues.
It also examines what happens when polished output arrives faster than professional judgment develops.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Keep the review table and responsibility document; use a pause before the colleague responds.

Speak with gentle concern; give gentle emphasis to professional judgment. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.

performance.note: Confidential curiosity: she relies on AI privately and closes the window the moment a colleague asks.

performance.gesture: reviewer holds the magnifier over one page, head and gaze down (held pose)
performance.note: Gentle concern: output keeps arriving while judgment has reached only one page.
